2608.19861.title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
2608.19861.paper_summary: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. PolicyGuide instead compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and invokes a proactive verifier at user-turn boundaries. From persisted graph state, the verifier reconciles open requests and returns step-specific remediation along a policy-compliant path. Across the $τ^2$-bench airline, retail, and telecom domains with a GPT-5.4 agent and verifier, PolicyGuide raises mean $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ from $0.42$ to $0.62$, with the largest gain on telecom ($0.19$ to $0.61$), the most workflow-structured domain. The same workflows transfer to Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Pro agents. Complementary evaluations find the lowest observed attack-success rate under adversarial users and the strongest procedural compliance in an author-designed workflow-level validation.
2608.19861.paper_summary_zh: 客戶服務 LLM 代理在代表用戶行事時必須遵循組織政策。合規失敗源於禁止的行為，例如授予不合格的變更，或省略的程序要求，例如身份識別或確認。運行時保護措施可以干預風險行為，但行動本地檢查並未指導代理完成多步驟程序。遵循工作流程的系統支持規定的過程執行，但主要目標是完成工作流程，而不是保護代理行為。PolicyGuide 則將每個領域的政策編譯成工作流程圖，並在用戶轉換邊界處調用主動驗證器。從持久化的圖狀態中，驗證器調和未完成的請求，並沿著符合政策的路徑返回特定步驟的補救措施。在 $τ^2$-bench 航空、零售和電信領域中，使用 GPT-5.4 代理和驗證器，PolicyGuide 將平均 $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ 從 $0.42$ 提高到 $0.62$，在電信領域的增幅最大（$0.19$ 到 $0.61$），該領域是最具工作流程結構的。相同的工作流程可轉移至 Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 代理。補充評估發現，在對抗性用戶下觀察到的最低攻擊成功率，以及在作者設計的工作流程級別驗證中最強的程序合規性。
